title: Profile
externalNote: You sign in through {providers}, so your password is managed there — not here.
hideMatureNote: Hide series marked mature from your Library, search, and reader — even though your role is allowed to see them. Nothing is deleted; turn this off any time to show it again.
languageNote: Applies to this account on every device. Menus, buttons and messages change; series and issue data stay in the language the metadata source provides.
apiKeyNote: A personal key for apps and scripts that talk to this BackIssue install — sent as an X-Api-Key header (or Authorization: Bearer). It can do exactly what your account can, nothing more.
copyNow: Copy it now — it won't be shown again.
scanNote: Scan in the BackIssue mobile app (Connect → Scan QR) to pair without typing.
noKey: No API key yet. Generate one to connect the mobile app or scripts.
replaceKeyMessage: A new key is generated and the current one stops working immediately. Anything using the old key must be updated.
revokeKeyMessage: The key stops working immediately. Anything using it loses access.
copyFailed: Copy failed — select and copy it manually.
signOutOthersMessage: Every other signed-in session is ended. This device stays signed in.
